throughput.note: written by ecc2k130/runner/aws/worker.py when ECC_METRICS_DIR names a node_exporter textfile-collector directory

issue.why: path-weighted SASS instructions per scalar update of the audited preset. The kernel issues 69-72 lane-instructions per SM-clock, above the 69.3 the probe measured for LOP3+IMAD, so the only measured issue rate that bounds it is the IADD3+FFMA dual-issue mix (78.3)

wide_multiply.why: IMAD.WIDE per update (144 per product, 5 5/32 products per update); the 31 B/s wide-multiply-only bound in THROUGHPUT-CEILING.md

launch.note: 512 resident threads = 16 of 48 warps per SM; the launch's own occupancy, not a goal to raise

provenance.source: ecc2k130/runner/THROUGHPUT-CEILING.md (CUDA 13.0.48 SASS of the direct-reducer preset)
provenance.note: demand changes whenever the kernel does; re-derive it from the SASS count after every instruction-count change or the score drifts silently
